shadows.label: 阴影 1 - Shadow 1
shadows.description: Typography is Proxima Nova — a humanist geometric sans that TikTok has used across the product since its re-brand from Musical.ly. It sits slightly warmer than a pure grotesque but more neutral than SF Pro, so captions and usernames read as content rather than chrome. The hierarchy is compact and overlay-friendly: sizes run 11-24pt, weights concentrated at 400 / 600 / 700, and almost everything that sits on a video uses a subtle `rgba(0,0,0,0.4)` drop shadow so the text stays legible over bright or busy frames. The only place display type appears is the Live / profile header; the feed itself never shows a headline larger than 17pt because the video is the headline.

shadows.label: 阴影 2 - Shadow 2
shadows.description: Default: `#FFFFFF` glyph with `rgba(0,0,0,0.25)` drop shadow (so it stays legible over video)

shadows.label: 阴影 3 - Shadow 3
shadows.description: | Text Shadow | `rgba(0,0,0,0.4) 0 1px 4px` | All text overlaid on video |

shadows.label: 阴影 4 - Shadow 4
shadows.description: | Icon Shadow | `rgba(0,0,0,0.25) 0 1px 3px` | Right-rail icons, top tabs |

borders.label: 边框 1 - Border 1
borders.description: Background: `rgba(1,1,1,0.92)` with `translucent backdrop blur` blur, 0.5pt top divider at `rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`

borders.label: 边框 2 - Border 2
borders.description: Pure White (`#FFFFFF`): Primary text on video, neutral icons, Create button core fill.

borders.label: 边框 3 - Border 3
borders.description: The accent system is built around a single, very loud idea: chromatic aberration. The TikTok wordmark splits the letter "d" into a cyan (`#25F4EE`) copy and a red / rose (`#FE2C55`) copy, offset a few pixels from the white original, mimicking the look of a 3D-glasses glitch or a VHS tape tracking error. Those two colors — cyan and rose — are the entire brand. Rose is the verb (the heart, the Follow button, the video scrubber, any "this is the action" moment). Cyan is the accent (the centered Create button, subtle highlights, loading states). White is neutral. Everything else is black or a hair-of-grey elevation. There is no secondary palette. There is no light mode.

panels.title: 面向真实界面片段
panels.body: 按钮、输入、卡片和间距样例保持克制，便于比较不同主题的系统性差异。

do: 建议：Use {#010101} as the canvas — true black, because video frames need the deepest possible bezel。
建议：Reserve rose {#FE2C55} for Like, Follow, scrubber fill, and any "this is the primary verb" moment。
建议：Use cyan {#25F4EE} sparingly — Create button and chromatic accents only。
建议：Apply the {rgba(0,0,0,0.4)} text shadow on every label sitting on top of a video。
建议：Use chromatic aberration (cyan -3pt X, rose +3pt X offset around a white core) on the wordmark, Create button, and loading spinner。
dont: 避免：use {#000000} — the brand token is {#010101}, a hair warmer。
避免：add secondary accent colors — cyan and rose are the only chromatic moments。
避免：use a light mode — TikTok is dark-only; there is no cream, no off-white canvas。
避免：use a full-pill corner on buttons — 4pt is the signature。
避免：let captions sit on video without a drop shadow — they become unreadable on bright frames。
